summary: Apply Space Is Fake science retirement to weapon and laboratory research continuations.
details: Weapon shooting speed 7 and Lab research speed 7 could retain space science because their base-continuation ingredient policy omitted the stream identity.

The shared qualifier and F200 adapter now apply compatibility exclusions after configured or expanded science selection, preserving upstream units, finite prerequisites, stable identities and mandatory progression packs.

Controlled regressions cover both planned level-7 technologies under all seven expansion settings and opposing ordinary-science and hard-gate cases. Exact native package, predecessor upgrade and reload qualification remains pending.
